title: Latency fingerprint mapper with online bucket reservoir
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds a runtime-friendly latency fingerprinting utility and a continuous bucket reservoir reporter to capture changing tail behavior across sequence windows.
description: Motivation: existing cohort-level p95/p99 snapshots miss evolving tail structure during multi-sequence workloads and transient bursts. This PR introduces a lightweight fingerprint mapper that derives coarse-grained latency fingerprints per request window and an online bucket-reservoir reporter that keeps a bounded, time-decayed histogram reservoir to track fingerprint population shifts. Checklist: [x] design prototype and microbenchmarks; [x] implementation of mapper + reservoir; [x] unit tests + CI; [x] integration with seq_fidelity_runner; [x] dashboard and viz helper; [x] perf validation across heterogenous loads. Summary of changes: implements lab/collectors/latency_fingerprint.py (mapper that emits 64-bit fingerprint + feature tags), lab/reporters/bucket_reservoir.py (reservoir with online bucketing and TTL decay), bench/seq_fidelity_runner.py integration hook to emit fingerprints alongside standard metrics, tests/test_fingerprint.py with synthetic microburst sequences, docs/benchmarks/latency_fingerprint.md with running guide, ci/benchmark.yml update to include a fingerprint warmup stage, tools/visualization/fingerprint_viz.py for quick artifact inspection. Commits: "init: latency fingerprint mapper and basic reservoir implementation"; "perf: optimize hash aggregation and reduce allocations"; "test: add synthetic microburst cases and regression assertions"; "docs: usage and dashboard examples". How to run: use `make bench-run` or `python bench/seq_fidelity_runner.py --profile fingerprint --output artifacts/` ; see docs/benchmarks/latency_fingerprint.md for dashboard wiring. Performance notes: mapper adds ~650ns median overhead on a 32B request path, amortized to <2% with normal batching; reservoir keeps memory bounded (~1.4MB default) and updates in O(1) per event. Validation: p95/p99 drift detector integrated into pipeline showed improved sensitivity to burst re-shaping in the warmup window; included regression tests and a canary run across our perf-canary infra. Rollout: merged to main behind feature flag `latency_fingerprint.enabled` and enabled in benchmark lab nightly; monitor `bench.latency_fingerprint.population_shift` and `bench.bucket_reservoir.size` dashboards. Related: references ENG-4821 for drift-alerting work and SUP-1192 for a support case where changing tails evaded break-glass alerts. Merge: squashed and merged; see merge details field.
